title: Motorcycle Passenger Grab Handle Belt, Single Pack Rider Waist Belt with 2 Textured Handles, Wide Padded Support for Two-Up Riding, No Drilling Installation
bullets: 【Single Pack, No Extra Cost】Most grab handle belts are sold in pairs. This one comes as a single belt, so you only pay for what you actually use - ideal if you usually ride with one passenger, or if you want to try the setup before committing to a pair.

【Two Textured Grips Right at the Waist】Instead of asking a passenger to hold onto your jacket or a backpack strap, this belt gives them two dedicated handholds with molded, grooved surfaces that stay easy to find by touch. Each side sits within natural reach.

【Wide Mesh Padding Spreads the Load】The back panel uses a wide, breathable mesh pad instead of a narrow strap. That spreads the pulling force across a larger area, which keeps the belt comfortable on longer rides and reduces pressure points around the waist.

【No Drilling, No Brackets, No Permanent Changes】The belt wraps around the rider's waist and fastens with a quick-release buckle - nothing is bolted to the bike. Put it on before you set off, take it off when you stop, and store it with your riding gear.

【Built to Take Load: Steel Rivets and Double Stitching】Reinforced attachment points use steel rivets, double-stitched nylon webbing and bound fabric edges to hold the handles securely. Note: this is a handhold aid for a passenger, not a safety restraint or seat belt.
description:
Riding two-up shouldn't mean your passenger has nothing to hold onto.

Most bikes leave the pillion with only the rider's jacket, a backpack strap, or a rear grab rail that sits too far back to reach comfortably. This rider-worn passenger grab belt solves that by putting two textured handholds exactly where your passenger's hands naturally fall - at the rider's waist.

Why riders pick this setup

  • Nothing bolted to the bike. The belt wraps around the rider and closes with a quick-release buckle, so no drilling, no brackets and no permanent changes.
  • Wide mesh padding. The back panel spreads pulling force over a larger area instead of digging in at one point.
  • Two grooved handles. Molded textured grips on both sides give each hand a defined spot, easy to find without looking.
  • Single pack. One belt, not a pair - you pay for the amount you actually need.
  • Reinforced build. Steel rivets, double-stitched nylon webbing and bound fabric edges hold the handles in place.

Specifications

  • Product Type: Motorcycle Passenger Grab Handle Belt
  • Color: Black
  • Main Construction: Woven fabric and nylon webbing
  • Handle Design: Two molded textured grips
  • Padding: Wide breathable mesh back panel
  • Fastening: Adjustable woven strap with quick-release buckle
  • Reinforcement: Steel rivets and double-stitched webbing
  • Package Dimensions: 25 x 17 x 4 cm
  • Package Weight: 0.27 kg
  • Package Includes: 1 x Motorcycle Passenger Grab Handle Belt

Before you ride

This product is a handhold aid for a passenger. It is not a safety restraint, seat belt or crash protection device. Check strap tension, confirm the buckle is fully engaged, and make sure your passenger can reach both handles comfortably with freedom of movement before setting off.
